description: TrafficLight surface shown. diAEControl.cpp DI_AEC_TrafficLight_Show (L245-255) sets sta_trafficLightStatus=RET_SHOW only when first_Cross_light_status_S is not 0 and not 1, val_display!=SIMPLE, sta_Navi==NAVI_ON and sta_vehicleConditionShow!=RET_SHOW. first_Cross_light_status_S is loaded (L164) from DiDCGetFirstcrosslightstatusS(), which reads EventSignal.FirstCrosslightstatusS populated by the First_Cross_light_status_S CAN callback (0x43F 2.2-2.4); feeding that frame with value 2 drives the event, so the signal becomes 2. val_display=1 (STANDARD) and gear!=1 keep the display/speed gates open. sta_Navi==NAVI_ON requires POWER_ON(val_power=3) and val_naviStatus in {2,3}: DiDcGetNavigationETH() reads hrinfo.navigating_status gated by someIpOnline.online_010A_01.status, enabled here via the 0x010A/0x01 someip channel. With all gates open diTrafficLightSurface renders the light texture, so primary label is shown.

mem.desc: gear!=1 keeps sta_vehicleConditionShow=RET_SHOW_NOT, satisfying the RET_SHOW != sta_vehicleConditionShow gate

someip.desc: navigation ETH channel online_010A_01.status=1 so DiDcGetNavigationETH() returns a non-zero navigating_status
